heroHeadline: CDC's Season-Wide Case Count Jumps to 18,445 as Outbreak Reaches 49 States
heroSubtitle: CDC's Sept 1 data refresh lifts the national season-wide lab-confirmed cyclosporiasis total to 18,445 (up 1,265 from Aug 25's 17,180), with hospitalizations rising to 990 and the outbreak now spanning 49 states plus DC. The narrower Taylor Farms/Taco Bell multistate outbreak, whose lettuce recall FDA upgraded to a Class I designation on Aug 28, still stands at 11,458 confirmed illnesses across 20 states with 495 hospitalizations and 2 unchanged deaths in Michigan as of CDC's Aug 27 update. Michigan's own state count, the largest in the outbreak, remains at 14,510 cases and 356 hospitalizations as of Aug 27.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
